meta.source: Hand-set by the research team (2026-10-02), pending a refit on pilot data from this app (the CSEDM data could not estimate the learn rate)
meta.notes: One parameter set per COSC3104/5 syllabus topic; topic order and lesson weeks live with the course in Convex. Replaces the earlier pyBKT fit on 5 students / 50 observations, whose degenerate values (learn=1.0, guess=slip=0) set mastery to 1.0 after a single submit. fit_bkt_baseline.py writes to bktParams.fitted.json for review; it never overwrites this file.
